edits.find: For creators choosing independent platforms, understanding technical specifications regarding payment processing and checkout security is vital. Official documentation from Stripe's guide to selling digital products underscores the importance of robust fraud protection (such as Stripe Radar) and instant, authenticated fulfillment delivery webhooks to prevent dispute spikes.
edits.replace:
Fees and policies change often, so confirm them on the official pages: Lemon Squeezy pricing, Gumroad pricing, Shopify pricing, and Etsy Fee Basics. Note that Lemon Squeezy's pricing page states it is no longer accepting new sign-ups and will shut down on March 31, 2027, so new sellers should choose another platform.

For creators choosing independent platforms, Stripe's guide on how to start a digital product business covers automatic delivery, tax handling with Stripe Tax, and adding fraud prevention as you grow. Stripe also offers Managed Payments, a merchant-of-record option for digital products that handles sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance in more than 80 countries.
